description: We are a group of teenagers in love with this ever-shifting universe, and we want nothing more than to pass that spark on to as many people as we can. We want to share with everyone our talent and passion for space in order to grow in the global scientific community and expand our knowledge.
summary:
What we do is bring the history of the past into our future – the youth.
Just as much as adults, little ones have the right to know about the probes and rovers that enable us to move forward and discover new things about our world. Six different missions, six different stories, little adventures in space, brought straight to your home with endearing characters such as the Viking twins, Sojourner – the first to visit Mars – and LM-5, the module that took the first humans to the Moon; Kepler, a silent adventurer; Ingenuity, an ambitious helicopter that was the first of its kind on Mars; and ALSEP, a multi-part entity.
details:
Our project, Via Stellarum, is built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Audacity. Its goal is to plant the seed of curiosity in children around the world, helping them grow into adults who truly understand the world around them.

As a team, we firmly believe that the project fosters critical thinking, sparks deep analysis of our environment, and helps users understand these concepts a little better through interactive screens, warm and engaging voice acting, and evocative music. This music makes us feel that we are part of something much greater—not just on Earth, but in the constantly expanding universe.

Finally, and just as importantly, we centered our work around creativity, seeing it as a fundamental bond that unites us as individuals and as a society. To achieve this, we focused closely on two key elements that are essential to our goal. First, we ensured that the way information is presented is tailored to our audience, featuring didactic explanations—such as illustrations to show what a space probe looks like, or a higher-pitched voice to represent a younger sibling, among other creative touches. Second, we wanted to break away from traditional formats where users simply flip pages, read, and repeat the same cycle over and over. Instead, we aimed to create a unique, unprecedented experience.

We brought this to life through a page-unlock system, where users must "complete" their current page to move forward. This introduces a subtle challenge that naturally sparks interest and curiosity, which in turn fosters creativity. By engaging with the material this way, the information takes root in the children's minds, flowing freely to inspire endless new ideas, challenges, and games.

And now, judges and readers, I sign off. On behalf of the entire team, we wish you the very best in your journey of seeking knowledge.
